channel.title: Salt Lake Tribune - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Salt Lake Tribune (sltrib.com)

item.title: Utah Jazz starter Keyonte George is back but wants to be ‘cautious’ as he returns from injury
item.description: After missing nine games because of two different ankle sprains, Utah Jazz point guard Keyonte George says he wants to be "cautious" as he returns from injury.

item.title: LDS Church releases statement on U.S., Israeli strikes in Iran
item.description: The church says all members in the Middle East are safe as it monitors U.S. and Israeli strikes in Iran.

item.title: The latest from Iran: Ayatollah Ali Khamenei was killed in U.S.-Israeli attacks
item.description: Here's the latest in the attack on Iran: The nation's supreme leader, Ayatollah Ali Khamenei, was killed in the major assault launched by the United States and Israel.

item.title: ‘It’s something that we’ve all manifested’: Real Salt Lake youngsters arrive with 2-1 win over Seattle
item.description: Real Salt Lake's youth starred in the team's home opener, lifting RSL to a 2-1 win over the Seattle Sounders.

item.title: Letter: Rep. Trevor Lee’s response to my Bible-based admonition about his immigration bill was startling
item.description: Letter: ​​In all my years communicating with our senators, my representatives, and our governor I have never been so rudely treated as I was by Trevor Lee.

item.title: Letter: Abortion bans lack charity and Christian kindness. Rep. Lisonbee has created the social stigma she seeks to ameliorate.
item.description: Letter: Latter-day Saints in Utah seem to have forgotten the fundamental Christian tenet of free agency as they seek to play God in private decisions between patients and doctors.

item.title: Letter: Unlike Rep. Pierucci and her armed constituent, I’ve been braving the mean streets of Salt Lake City without fear for decades
item.description: Letter: Candice Pierucci and her armed constituent cling to their guns like Linus clings to his security blanket.

item.title: Opinion: Liberal democracy in America lost its nerve in 2025. Has it run its course?
item.description: Opinion: The great capitulation is over. This should be the year that liberal democracy fights back, in earnest.

item.title: Letter: If it came to it, would Utahns respond like Minnesotans did? Would Utah leaders defend democratic norms under threat?
item.description: Letter: Minnesota showed the nation what it looks like when ordinary people refuse to let authoritarianism take hold. If Utah were confronted with the same test, what would we do?

item.title: Tribune Editorial: If masks are good enough for ICE, they are good enough for the people
item.description: “If Utah lawmakers aren’t going to make federal goons acting under color of law show their faces, they should give the people standing up for their, and everyone’s, constitutional rights the same protections,” writes the editorial board.
